target: P09 local QGIS project and WPF readback regression
application_version: QGIS 4.2.3-Belém do Pará, .NET SDK 10.0.300, WPF host .NET 10.0.8
python_runtime: QGIS Windows Python via python-qgis.bat and CPython 3.14.7
crs_units: Geographic data EPSG:4326 in degrees. Saved QGIS project view EPSG:3857 in projected metres. No distance or area measurement.
fixtures_used: temporary 2 x 2 synthetic GeoTIFF and two control points
expected_result: Two EPSG:4326 features; preserved project CRS, extent, layer state and one NoData cell; separate UI Automation click yields three valid cells.
observed_result: QGIS independently reopened 2 features with EPSG:4326, project EPSG:3857, NoData -9999, and 1 missing cell. WPF reported 3 valid cells and one click from the separate client.
not_tested: ArcGIS Pro SDK add-in installation or execution
known_limitations: Synthetic local fixtures and isolated application session only.
source_changes: Read-only fixture inputs. New outputs written to scratch. r6 repository changes include reference matching and documentation.
provenance_licensing: Repository-owned synthetic fixtures covered by the repository MIT license. Installed runtimes remain separate prerequisites.
